dependency_reason: Array dumping recursively increases traversal depth.
The API test supplies nested arrays beyond the limit and checks that dumping fails.
json_loadb returns the value produced by parse_json.
Parsing starts at depth zero and delegates value construction to parse_value.
parse_value increments depth and rejects values beyond JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
Callback dumping invokes do_dump at depth zero; string dumping delegates to callback dumping.
